intro.text: A greatshell with a sizable gemheart. In Marabethia, condemned criminals may hang from seaside cliffs as bait for yu-nerig, and are pardoned if they last a week uneaten.
A sea greatshell of the Reshi Sea, often seen near Marabethia and Herdaz. Marabethians hang condemned criminals from seaside cliffs as bait for it.

description.text: Like all greatshells, yu-nerig have gemhearts: smaller than a chasmfiend's, but still sizable.

Under Marabethian law a condemned criminal may hang over a seaside cliff at high tide, a cut in each cheek, to win a pardon by surviving a week. Most are attacked on the first day, yet most still take the chance. The Marabethian saying about having eyes "of red and blue" comes from this: such a prisoner sees only blood and sea.
Yu-nerig are known for their succulent flavor.
Yu-nerig live in the sea depths and come ashore only to pupate, in chrysalises shaped and textured much like a chasmfiend's.
Like most Rosharan creatures, yu-nerig form bonds with spren.
